results.answer_en: Recall on the students who needed support. Most students were fine, so Accuracy looks high even if you miss the ones who matter. Missing a struggling student is worse than one extra follow-up. I still watched Precision so the list did not flood teachers.

results.match_question: How do you know whether the problem is the embedding model, retrieval, prompt, or LLM?
results.answer_en: I treat it as a pipeline test. If the gold chunk is not in the index, it is ingest or chunking. If it is in the index but not in top-k, it is embedding, filters, or query wording. If it is in the prompt and the model still fails, it is the prompt or the model, not retrieval.
